blocks.text:
To: James Garcia
Cc: Michelle Banks

That clears the treaty terms, thank you. With the inception years confirmed and your mapping in hand, the premium and loss records tie together, and the treaty schedule for the {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}} review is settled on our end. The mapping in particular saves us a good deal of guesswork, so thank you for pulling it together.

One piece is still open before we can measure the experience. The loss file you sent gives paid amounts only. To set the experience against the pricing, we need the case reserves alongside the paid figures, treaty by treaty, so that we work from the incurred position rather than from what has been paid out so far. The paid figures on their own understate the position on the longer-tailed treaties, which is exactly where the pricing question is sharpest. Whatever your system exports is fine; we would rather reconcile from your native report than have your staff reshape it for us.

Michelle Banks will fold the reserve detail in as soon as it arrives, and that closes the intake for Gonzalez, Campbell and Kelly. Once it is in, we can give you a first read on where the pricing is holding. There is no rush before next week.
